## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] package/tarball checks when exports or packaging changed

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] public API and runtime behavior remain compatible, or the compatibility impact is documented
- [ ] request/delivery ownership remains explicit
- [ ] cancellation and cleanup behavior is covered where relevant
- [ ] Node-only behavior does not leak into the portable package surface
- [ ] publish credentials are not exposed to dependency installation or build steps
